title: Teaching an agent to write diagrams

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: How do you get an AI agent to draw a decent diagram? Give it good instructions.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That's uml-skill, a bundle of diagram-writing guidance for agents, plus a small Python helper.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Is it a server, or a model that draws pictures?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Neither, and that's the design. It's a skill bundle: prompts and tool definitions that guide the agent. The agent writes the diagram source itself.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: A fallback. It can turn diagram source into a Kroki link, so you can still get an image when nothing fancier is available. It's under 3 thousand bytes of code.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Exactly. The full page has the instructions.
